## What's new

### Smoother reading
- **Skeleton loading.** Picking a surah now shows a page-shaped placeholder right away, in Verse by Verse, Translation and Reading modes, instead of a blank view. Pages wait for their Mushaf font before showing.
- **Both pages together.** In two-page mode the left and right pages now appear at the same moment, even when one loads faster.
- **Steadier surah list.** The sidebar keeps its scroll position, and picking a surah no longer flashes a different one first. A new setting can highlight every surah on the current page.
- **Arabic surah names** now match the size of the English name beside them.

### Mushaf & script
- **All styles in one place.** The page-style categories are gone. Madani Mushaf, Tajweed, Uthmani, IndoPak, Naskh, Amiri Quran and Scheherazade are shown together, with a separate Madani or IndoPak page layout choice. Your existing choices carry over.

### Player bar
- **Speed picker.** Click the speed button to choose a playback speed from a list. The button fits its label and no longer shifts the icons beside it.
- **Volume by scroll.** The volume slider is replaced by the speaker icon: scroll over it to change the volume (the percentage shows), and click it to mute or unmute.
- **A more compact bar** with more even spacing between the buttons.

### A more consistent look
- **One calm selected style** across toggles, switches, pickers, menus and list rows: a solid neutral fill with a thin outline, no coloured highlights.
- **Larger theme previews**, five to a row, in Settings.
- **Scrollbar and window edge.** The sidebar scrollbar no longer collides with the window resize grip.

### Tighter and safer
- The web inspector is removed, and the app now only connects to the hosts it needs (Quran.com, the audio servers and the font CDN).
- **Windows installer.** The Finish page now starts the app reliably.
